description: Overlay window scoped permissions — no auth, store, shortcut, or window-state access. core:default — basic Tauri runtime IPC so the overlay can invoke custom commands (overlay_toggle_mute, overlay_leave_call, overlay_close, show_overlay, hide_overlay). allow-start-dragging — pill drag support. allow-set-ignore-cursor-events — click-through toggle (Ctrl+Shift). allow-outer-position and allow-set-position — edge-snap on drag-release.
